        <commentText>This statement on Schedule 13D (this "Statement") relates to the Class B ordinary shares, par value US$0.0024 per share (the "Class B Ordinary Shares"), of Trident Digital Tech Holdings Ltd, a Cayman Islands exempted company with limited liability (the "Issuer"). The principal executive offices of the Issuer are located at Suntec Tower 3, 8 Temasek Boulevard Road, #24-03, Singapore 038988. The Class B Ordinary Shares are listed on the Nasdaq Capital Market under the symbol "TDTH." The current CUSIP is G90475115.</commentText>

        <filingPersonName>This Statement is filed jointly by Soon Huat Lim ("Mr. Lim"), a citizen of the Republic of Singapore; Trident Digital Tech Ltd ("Trident Digital Tech"); Tri Wealth Ltd ("Tri Wealth"); and Trident Group Holdings Ltd ("Trident Group Holdings," and collectively with Mr. Lim, the "Reporting Persons"). Each of the three entities is organized under the laws of the British Virgin Islands and is wholly owned and controlled by Mr. Lim.</filingPersonName>
        <principalBusinessAddress>The principal business address of Mr. Lim is Suntec Tower 3, 8 Temasek Boulevard Road, #24-03, Singapore 038988. The principal business address of each entity is Sertus Chambers, P.O. Box 905, Quastisky Building, Road Town, Tortola, British Virgin Islands.</principalBusinessAddress>
        <principalJob>Mr. Lim is the founder, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of the Issuer. The principal business of each corporate Reporting Person is Investment Holding Company. Mr. Lim is the controlling person for each corporate Reporting Person.</principalJob>

      <item3>
        <fundsSource>Mr. Lim beneficially owns the Class B Ordinary Shares described in Item 5 both directly and indirectly through the three wholly owned and controlled entities named in Item 2. As of November 16, 2026, the direct holdings include shares issued in the debt conversions described below and other shares acquired or held previously.

On June 30, 2026, Mr. Lim and the Issuer entered into a Share Subscription Agreement (the "July Conversion Agreement") pursuant to which the Issuer agreed to satisfy US$8,000,000 of outstanding indebtedness owed to Mr. Lim by issuing 901,408,450 Class B Ordinary Shares, on a pre-consolidation basis, at a conversion price of US$0.008875 per share. The transaction was approved by the Issuer's shareholders on July 8, 2026 and was subsequently completed in July 2026, as reported by the Issuer. The Issuer effected a 240-for-1 consolidation of its ordinary shares effective July 16, 2026.

On October 31, 2026, the Issuer issued a demand grid promissory note to Mr. Lim (the "Note") evidencing amounts previously advanced by Mr. Lim as working capital loans. As of October 31, 2026, the Note evidenced outstanding principal of approximately US$5,125,000. On November 6, 2026, Mr. Lim and the Issuer entered into a Debt Conversion Agreement (the "November Conversion Agreement"), pursuant to which US$3,000,000 of the indebtedness evidenced by the Note was converted into 4,615,384 Class B Ordinary Shares at a conversion price of US$0.65 per share. The Issuer issued the shares on November 11, 2026, in satisfaction and discharge of the converted indebtedness, without the payment of additional cash consideration by Mr. Lim. The remainder of the Note remains outstanding in accordance with its terms.

The July Conversion Agreement, the Note and the November Conversion Agreement are described in Items 4 and 6 and are incorporated by reference to the Issuer's filings identified in Item 7.</fundsSource>
      </item3>
      <item4>
        <transactionPurpose>Mr. Lim acquired the Class B Ordinary Shares in connection with the transactions described in Item 3, including the conversion of founder working capital loans into equity of the Issuer. The July and November debt conversions replaced outstanding liabilities of the Issuer with equity and were disclosed by the Issuer as measures to strengthen its balance sheet and preserve cash. Mr. Lim is the founder, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of the Issuer and, through his direct and indirect holdings, is a substantial beneficial owner of its equity securities.

The Class B Ordinary Shares acquired under the November Conversion Agreement were issued as restricted securities. On October 28, 2026, the Issuer announced that Mr. Lim intends to purchase up to 1,000,000 Class B Ordinary Shares in the open market using his personal funds, at prices not exceeding US$1.00 per share, subject to applicable securities laws and market conditions. The timing and amount of any such purchases remain subject to Mr. Lim's discretion.

Depending on various factors including, without limitation, the outcome of any discussions referenced above, the Issuer's financial position, strategic direction, business and prospects, anticipated future developments, existing and anticipated market conditions from time to time, actions taken by the Issuer's management and Board, price levels of the Ordinary Shares, general economic conditions and regulatory matters, the Reporting Persons may in the future take such actions with respect to their investment in the Issuer as they deem appropriate including, without limitation, purchasing additional Ordinary Shares or other securities of the Issuer (which may include rights or securities exercisable or convertible into securities of the Issuer), selling or otherwise disposing some or all of their Ordinary Shares (which may include, but is not limited to, transferring some or all of such securities to its affiliates or distributing some or all of such securities to such Reporting Persons' respective partners, members or beneficiaries, as applicable) or engaging in hedging or similar transaction with respect to the Ordinary Shares, in each case, in open market or private transactions, block sales or otherwise to the extent permitted under applicable law. Except for the foregoing, the Reporting Persons do not have, as of the date of this filing, any plans or proposals that relate to or would result in any of the actions or events specified in clauses (a) through (j) of Item 4 of Schedule 13D; provided, that the Reporting Persons at any time and from time to time, may review or reconsider and change their position and/or change their purpose and/or develop such plans.</transactionPurpose>
      </item4>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: right"><B>Exhibit 1</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: right"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center; background-color: white">JOINT FILING AGREEMENT</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center; background-color: white">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.25in; background-color: white">Each
of the undersigned hereby agrees that this Amendment to Schedule 13D, dated November 16, 2026, with respect to the common shares of Trident
Digital Tech Holdings Ltd (the &ldquo;Schedule 13D&rdquo;) is, and any and all subsequent amendments thereto shall be, filed on behalf
of each of the undersigned pursuant to and in accordance with the provisions of Rule 13d-1(k) under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934,
as amended, and that this Joint Filing Agreement shall be included as an exhibit to the Schedule 13D and any amendments thereto. Each
of the undersigned agrees to be responsible for the timely filing of any amendments to the Schedule 13D, and for the completeness and
accuracy of the information concerning itself contained therein, but shall not be responsible for the completeness and accuracy of the
information concerning any other party hereto or thereto, except to the extent that it knows or has reason to believe that such information
is inaccurate. This Joint Filing Agreement may be executed in any number of counterparts, all of which taken together shall constitute
one and the same instrument.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.25in; background-color: white">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.25in; background-color: white">IN
WITNESS WHEREOF, this Joint Filing Agreement has been executed and delivered by each of the undersigned as of November 16, 2026.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.25in; background-color: white">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; background-color: white">Date: February 14, 2025</P>
